summary: Phase A — Decision step-share collaboration. Backend regression: all 3 pytest tests passed (allow_reshare stored & returned in /shared-steps/received, recipient reshare adds pending_invites with invited_by_name attribution, reshare blocked 403 when allow_reshare=false, non-recipient blocked 403, /contribute accepts `consolidated`). Frontend (Expo web @ mobile 390x844): (1) ShareStepModal on Step 2 shows the new checkbox 'Allow recipients to seek further help' with testID share-allow-reshare; clicking toggles state. (2) Share-button gate confirmed: visible on Step 2, HIDDEN on Step 10 (Final Decision). Step 1 is not navigable from the step-strip in prr/[id].tsx (UI strip starts at 2), so the source gate `currentStep>=2 && currentStep<=9` covers both ends. (3) Inbox '/inbox' renders received shares correctly. Contribute modal: when allow_reshare=true, the 'Consolidated recommendation' textarea + 'Seek further help' email input (testID inbox-forward-email) + Forward button (testID inbox-forward-btn) are present; when allow_reshare=false, all three are absent. Forwarding via the UI succeeded — POST /reshare 200 and 'Forwarded' alert shown.
action_items: (Optional, polish) Add a testID to the share button in app/prr/[id].tsx (e.g., testID="share-step-btn") so future automation can target it directly instead of via icon/position heuristics.
(Optional, polish) Add a SafeAreaView edges hint or testIDs to the prr/[id].tsx step indicator buttons so step-navigation in tests is more reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: sharing.py line 232: `email == share.get('owner_id')` compares an email string to a user_id; harmless (never true) but misleading — should likely be `email == owner_email` if the intent is to block reshare-to-owner.
Inbox.tsx imports `Alert` from react-native but uses `showAlert` everywhere — `Alert` import is unused (lint nit).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (share toggle, step-10 gate, inbox forward/consolidated controls visibility, forward action)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_iter145_ui decision (admin@test.com) with two shares to super@test.com (Step 7 allow_reshare=true, Step 4 allow_reshare=false). Cleaned up after testing. Pytest tests also create+delete their own TEST_iter145_* decisions per-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses session_token (not 'token') in login response — pass as `Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`. Backend stores emails lowercased; assertions on forwarded/invited emails must lowercase the expected value. Frontend share button in prr/[id].tsx lacks a testID — use position heuristics (sibling of videocam button with bg rgb(220,252,231)) or navigate via URL ?step=N. Inbox Contribute button can be clicked by walking up from the card's message text (e.g., 'TEST allow=TRUE') to the nearest ancestor containing a 'Contribute' text node.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all flows working as specified.
